title: strophostyles helvola
intro: Strophostyles helvola, commonly known as Buffalo Bean, is a perennial plant that belongs to the legume family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Strophostyles helvola include its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which help to relieve symptoms of coughs, colds, and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
